# VibeStack Rankings

> Opinionated, ranked AI tools for vibe coders and builders, with honest verdicts, pricing notes (always pointing to official pricing) and official links. Sponsored placements are always labelled and never affect rankings.

## Rankings
- [Coding agents](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/coding-agents.html): What should I use to write and edit code with an AI agent? Picks: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf
- [AI app builders](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/app-builders.html): What should I use to go from prompt to a working app? Picks: Lovable, Bolt, Replit, v0
- [Databases & backends](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/databases.html): What should I use for my database, auth and backend? Picks: Supabase, Firebase, Neon, Convex
- [Hosting & deploy](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/hosting.html): Where should I deploy my app? Picks: Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, Render
- [AI APIs & models](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/ai-apis.html): Which model API should my app call? Picks: OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Google Gemini API, OpenRouter, Groq
- [Agent frameworks](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/agent-frameworks.html): What should I use to build my own AI agent? Picks: OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Vercel AI SDK, CrewAI, n8n
- [Best for vibe coding](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/vibe-coding.html): I can't code (much). What should I use to ship? Picks: Lovable, Replit, Cursor, Bolt
- [Video](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/video.html): What should I use to make AI video? Picks: Runway, Google Veo (Flow), Kling AI, HeyGen
- [Voice](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/category/voice.html): What should I use for AI voice, TTS or voice agents? Picks: ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime API, Vapi, Deepgram

## Guides
- [AI Agent Hosting Options: Where to Run Your Agents in Production](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/ai-agent-hosting-options.html): Where to host AI agents: serverless functions, long-running servers, background workers and queues, durable workflows, and self-hosted automation, with trade-offs for each.

- [AI Tools for Solo Founders: A Practical Stack to Build, Launch and Grow](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/ai-tools-for-solo-founders.html): The AI tools solo founders actually need: building the product, backend and hosting, automation, content and video, support and voice, with a lean starter stack.
- [Lovable vs Bolt vs Replit vs v0: The Best AI App Builders Compared](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-app-builders.html): Lovable, Bolt, Replit and v0 compared: what each AI app builder does best, who it suits, and how to pick one for your MVP.
- [Best AI Code Editor in 2026: Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot and the Alternatives](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-code-editor-2026.html): How to choose the best AI code editor in 2026: Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code with GitHub Copilot, and terminal agents like Claude Code and Codex, with a practical decision guide.
- [The Best AI Coding Agents for Builders in 2026](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-coding-agents.html): An honest guide to the best AI coding agents in 2026, including Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex and Windsurf, and how to pick one for your workflow.
- [Best AI Tools for Beginners to Build Apps (No Coding Experience Needed)](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-tools-for-beginners-to-build-apps.html): The best AI tools for complete beginners who want to build an app: which builder to start with, what to add next, and a simple learning path.
- [Best AI Tools for Game Developers and Indie Devs](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-tools-for-game-developers.html): A practical guide to AI tools for game developers: coding assistants for engines, art and asset generation, audio and voice, and how to use them responsibly.
- [The Best AI Video Generators for Creators and Builders](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-video-generators.html): Runway, Google Veo (Flow), Kling AI and HeyGen compared: which AI video generator to use for clips, ads, explainers and translated videos.
- [The Best AI Voice Tools: TTS, Speech-to-Text and Voice Agents](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-ai-voice-tools.html): ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime API, Vapi and Deepgram compared for text-to-speech, transcription and building voice agents.

- [The Best Free AI Tools for Developers and Vibe Coders](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-free-ai-tools-for-developers.html): A curated list of AI tools for developers with genuine free tiers: coding agents, app builders, databases, hosting, model APIs and agent frameworks.
- [Best MCP Servers for Cursor: Useful Integrations and How to Set Them Up](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/best-mcp-servers-for-cursor.html): The most useful kinds of MCP servers to connect to Cursor (GitHub, browser automation, databases, deployment, docs and error tracking), how to configure them, and how to stay safe.
- [Claude Code Tutorial for Beginners: Install, First Task and Good Habits](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/claude-code-tutorial-for-beginners.html): A beginner-friendly Claude Code tutorial: what it is, how to install it, running your first task, using CLAUDE.md project memory, permissions, and habits that get better results.

- [Claude vs GPT for Coding: How to Choose the Right Model](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/claude-vs-gpt-for-coding.html): Claude vs GPT for coding compared in practical terms: tools built on each, how to test them on your code, cost considerations and when to use both.
- [Cursor Rules Examples: Practical Templates for Better AI Code](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/cursor-rules-examples.html): Practical Cursor rules examples you can adapt: project overview, coding style, testing, framework-specific and security rules, plus how Cursor rules files work.

- [MCP Explained: What the Model Context Protocol Is and Why Builders Care](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/mcp-explained.html): The Model Context Protocol (MCP) explained in plain English: what servers and clients are, how AI tools use MCP, how to build or use an MCP server, and security tips.
- [Neon vs Supabase: Which Postgres Should You Use?](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/neon-vs-supabase.html): Neon vs Supabase compared: serverless Postgres with branching versus a full backend platform. When you need just a database and when you need more.
- [OpenRouter Guide: One API Key for Hundreds of AI Models](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/openrouter-guide.html): What OpenRouter is, when it makes sense versus calling OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini directly, and how to use it for model comparison and fallbacks.

- [Vibe Coding Security Checklist: 12 Things to Check Before You Launch](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/vibe-coding-security-checklist.html): A practical security checklist for AI-built and vibe-coded apps: secrets, database access rules, auth, input validation, dependencies and more.
- [Vibe Coding Tools List: Every Tool You Need, by Stage](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/vibe-coding-tools-list.html): A curated vibe coding tools list organised by stage: idea and UI, app builders, AI code editors and agents, backend, AI APIs, deployment, automation and media.
- [Windsurf vs Cursor: Which AI IDE Should You Use?](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/blog/windsurf-vs-cursor.html): Windsurf vs Cursor compared for builders: editor experience, agent features, pricing model, and how to decide between the two AI-first IDEs.

## Agent Tools
- [Agent Tools](https://vibestack-rankings.vercel.app/agent-tools.html): open-source MCP servers and CLI tools for AI agents
- [GitHub MCP Server](https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server): Official GitHub control for agents
- [Playwright MCP](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp): Browser automation by Microsoft
- [Context7](https://github.com/upstash/context7): Up-to-date docs for AI agents
- [MCP Reference Servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers): Filesystem, Git, Fetch, Memory and more
- [Supabase MCP](https://github.com/supabase/mcp): Connect Supabase to your agent
- [Stripe Agent Toolkit](https://github.com/stripe/ai): Payments tools for agents
- [Cloudflare MCP](https://github.com/cloudflare/mcp-server-cloudflare): Workers, logs, DNS and more
- [Firecrawl MCP](https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server): Web scraping and search
- [Exa MCP](https://github.com/exa-labs/exa-mcp-server): AI-native web search
- [Notion MCP](https://github.com/makenotion/notion-mcp-server): Official Notion workspace access
- [Slack MCP Server](https://github.com/korotovsky/slack-mcp-server): Community Slack control
- [Sentry Agent Toolkit](https://github.com/getsentry/toolkit): Agentic tooling for Sentry
- [AWS MCP Servers](https://github.com/awslabs/mcp): Open-source MCP for AWS
- [MCP Toolbox for Databases](https://github.com/googleapis/mcp-toolbox): Google's database MCP server
- [MongoDB MCP Server](https://github.com/mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server): MongoDB and Atlas access
- [Neon MCP Server](https://github.com/neondatabase/mcp-server-neon): Serverless Postgres control
- [Grafana MCP](https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana): Dashboards, alerts and queries
- [Terraform MCP Server](https://github.com/hashicorp/terraform-mcp-server): Infrastructure as code for agents
- [Composio](https://github.com/ComposioHQ/composio): 1000+ toolkits with managed auth
- [ToolHive](https://github.com/stacklok/toolhive): Run MCP servers securely
- [Docker MCP Gateway](https://github.com/docker/mcp-gateway): docker mcp CLI plugin
- [MCP Inspector](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector): Test and debug MCP servers
- [GitHub CLI](https://github.com/cli/cli): gh, GitHub from the terminal
- [Vercel CLI](https://github.com/vercel/vercel): Deploy from any agent
- [Vercel MCP Handler](https://github.com/vercel-labs/mcp-handler): Ship MCP servers on Next.js
- [Supabase CLI](https://github.com/supabase/cli): Migrations, local dev, edge functions
- [Stripe CLI](https://github.com/stripe/stripe-cli): Stripe from the terminal
